@@ P01 drop partition child of registered
DROP TABLE aveloxis_data.repos_part
@@ P02 truncate partition child
TRUNCATE aveloxis_data.repos_part
@@ P03 drop ancestor cascade (drops registered child)
DROP TABLE aveloxis_data.anc CASCADE
@@ P04 truncate ancestor (truncates children too, no CASCADE needed)
TRUNCATE aveloxis_data.anc
@@ P05 update ancestor (updates registered child's rows; only ancestor's columns)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.anc SET id = 1
@@ P06 delete from ancestor (deletes registered rows)
DELETE FROM aveloxis_data.anc
@@ P07 child no inherit
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos_part NO INHERIT aveloxis_data.repos
@@ P08 alter ancestor alter column type (rewrites children)
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.anc ALTER COLUMN id TYPE bigint
@@ P09 alter child partition drop column / alter type ar
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos_part ALTER COLUMN ar TYPE int USING 0
@@ P10 rename partition child / set schema
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos_part RENAME TO zzz
@@ P11 ar from partition child in FROM
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = p.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos_part p WHERE p.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ P12 ar from ancestor in FROM (ancestor shows only its own columns: ok)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = p.id FROM aveloxis_data.anc p
@@ P13 trigger on partition child
CREATE TRIGGER t BEFORE UPDATE ON aveloxis_data.repos_part FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION f()
@@ P14 rule on child
CREATE RULE r AS ON UPDATE TO aveloxis_data.repos_part DO INSTEAD NOTHING
@@ P15 copy into child
COPY aveloxis_data.repos_part (ar) FROM STDIN
@@ P16 fk on child col
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos_part ADD FOREIGN KEY (ar) REFERENCES aveloxis_data.other (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
